nodes.name: document.rs
nodes.summary: Core Document implementation for the Servo browser engine, implementing the DOM Document interface with lifecycle management, script loading, rendering, stylesheet handling, animation timing, intersection observers, and navigation history.
nodes.languageNotes: Rust implementation of core DOM interfaces using Servo's DomRefCell, JS tracing, and script layout patterns.
